message.reasoning:
The owner wants core animations, cmux included, and this one is a plain screen recording of a browser pane mostly covering the terminal. The earlier laptop and fleet panel got an EDIT because of how the recording skewed, and a flat window like this might read as boring, so it's a hard call.

I'm weighing whether this one needs an edit, since the terminal pane is buried behind the browser and the title promises "every agent" while only one browser shows up. The "Six lanes in cmux" poster landed well, and this one is mostly the STRIVE page, so I'm leaning toward EDIT THIS ONE, though new content is also possible.
